register.labelZh: PILE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: pile in 和 pile out 可以清楚描述一群人迅速一起進入或離開交通工具或地方。；pile into somebody or something 可以描述人、車輛或物件猛撞上另一個人或物件。；體重可以 pile on;積雪、工作、訊息和碟子則可以 pile up。；pile on the drama、pile on the agony 和 pile on the gloom 可以描述把事情說得更誇張、更痛苦或更悲觀。
register.summaryEn: Pile in and pile out clearly describe a group of people entering or leaving a vehicle or place quickly together. Pile into somebody or something can describe people, vehicles or objects crashing into one another. Weight can pile on, while snow, work, messages and dishes can pile up. Pile on the drama, pile on the agony and pile on the gloom describe different ways of making something sound stronger, worse or more serious.
contextsEn: Talk about things increasing or collecting
